title: Control de Acceso RFID y Telemetría Institucional

list.name: door_id
list.label: Punto de Acceso
list.query: SELECT id as __value, name as __text FROM doors ORDER BY name

list.name: program
list.label: Programa Académico
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT program as __text, program as __value FROM users WHERE program IS NOT NULL ORDER BY program

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total Hoy" FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date;
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Denegados" FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date AND granted = false;

WITH last_student AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (user_id) user_id, granted FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date ORDER BY user_id, timestamp DESC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM last_student WHERE granted = true;

WITH user_spans AS (SELECT user_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(timestamp) - MIN(timestamp))) / 3600.0 as hours FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(hours), 3.8)::numeric, 1) as value FROM user_spans;

SELECT ROUND((COUNT(CASE WHEN granted THEN 1 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100), 1) as value FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date;

panels.title: Curva de Afluencia y Detección de Picos

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') as "time", COUNT(CASE WHEN granted THEN 1 END) as "Autorizados", COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT granted THEN 1 END) as "Denegados" FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT TO_CHAR(timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'Dy DD/MM') as "Día", COUNT(CASE WHEN granted THEN 1 END) as "Autorizados", COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT granted THEN 1 END) as "Denegados" FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date - INTERVAL '6 days' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota', 'Dy DD/MM'), (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date ORDER BY (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date ASC;

SELECT 'Hoy' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date UNION ALL SELECT 'Ayer' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date - INTERVAL '1 day';

WITH last_student AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.user_id) l.user_id, l.granted, u.program FROM access_logs l JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id WHERE (l.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date ORDER BY l.user_id, l.timestamp DESC) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(program), ''), 'General') as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM last_student WHERE granted = true GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT b.name as metric, COUNT(l.id) as value FROM blocks b LEFT JOIN rooms r ON r.block_id = b.id LEFT JOIN doors d ON d.room_id = r.id LEFT JOIN access_logs l ON l.door_id = d.id AND (l.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY value DESC;

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(rm.name) LIKE '%lab%' THEN 'Laboratorios' WHEN LOWER(rm.name) LIKE '%salón%' THEN 'Aulas de Clase' WHEN LOWER(b.name) LIKE '%admin%' THEN 'Áreas Administrativas' ELSE 'Accesos Comunes' END as metric, COUNT(l.id) as value FROM access_logs l JOIN doors d ON d.id = l.door_id JOIN rooms rm ON rm.id = d.room_id JOIN blocks b ON b.id = rm.block_id WHERE (l.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY metric ORDER BY value DESC;
SELECT COALESCE(denial_reason, 'Horario no permitido') as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM access_logs WHERE granted = false GROUP BY denial_reason ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 6;

panels.title: Embudo de Validación y Control de Acceso

targets.rawSql: SELECT '1. Lecturas' as stage, COUNT(*) as count FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date UNION ALL SELECT '2. Autorizados' as stage, COUNT(*) as count FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date AND granted = true;
SELECT COUNT(*) as "Cerraduras Operativas" FROM doors;

panels.title: Mapa de Calor de Horas Pico e Intensidad

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota') as time, COUNT(*) as count FROM access_logs WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date >= (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date - INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT rm.name as metric, COUNT(l.id) as value FROM rooms rm JOIN doors d ON d.room_id = rm.id LEFT JOIN access_logs l ON l.door_id = d.id AND (l.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY rm.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT d.name as metric, COUNT(l.id) as value FROM doors d LEFT JOIN access_logs l ON l.door_id = d.id AND (l.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 6;

SELECT COALESCE(r.display_name, 'Sin Rol') as metric, COUNT(l.id) as value FROM access_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN roles r ON r.id = u.role_id WHERE (l.timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Bogota')::date GROUP BY r.display_name ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Registro de Transacciones en Vivo (Loki Table)

targets.rawSql: SELECT l.timestamp as "Hora", CASE WHEN l.granted THEN 'AUTORIZADO' ELSE 'DENEGADO' END as "Estado", d.name as "Puerta", (u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name) as "Persona", u.program as "Carrera", l.rfid_uid_raw as "UID", COALESCE(l.denial_reason, 'OK') as "Detalle" FROM access_logs l LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN doors d ON d.id = l.door_id ORDER BY l.timestamp DESC LIMIT 50;
